name: Ping Ho
summary: Established in 1995 and headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, Ping Ho Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in comprehensive water management solutions. The company provides industrial wastewater and sewage treatment, alongside operational services for such facilities. Furthermore, Ping Ho is active in the reclamation of various liquid wastes, including ammonia nitrogen wastewater and spent pickling liquids, as well as general waste liquid recycling. They also produce and distribute essential basic chemicals and specialized chemicals for water treatment applications.
